focus: P5 temporal supersession contract and separate nogood admission spec-vs-code audit
noveltyJustification: This pass closes P5 with a two-axis ordering rule, composite validity and tie semantics, late-arrival behavior, cycle/competition admission, and a verified Graphene/036 temporal gap; it separately proves that nogood refusal is absent from Graphene admission and isolates the refusal/backstop split.
keyFindings: ObservationOrderKey combines observed_at with authorized append sequence: observed time governs semantic replacement, while sequence governs replay and breaks equal-time ties
Graphene's production Supersede fold bypasses its observed-time comparator, closes validity at receipt time, and its out-of-order golden fixture contains no out-of-order observation or supersession
Validity intervals must be half-open over composite observation keys so equal-time revisions and older late arrivals are deterministic without deleting history
Supersession admission must preview the effective relation graph and reject non-increasing observation keys, cycles, and competing active successors before sequence allocation
The 036 relationship projection enforces structural ordering by verified ledger sequence but its payload and projection have no machine-checkable observed-time or validity contract
Graphene's stated add-time nogood rejection is absent from the fold; G8 and its fixtures detect an invalid all-IN set only after admission
Nogood safety requires prospective fixed-point refusal at the authority boundary plus G8 as a replay/corruption invariant backstop
